summary: Iteration 3 verified the enhanced CASE MANAGEMENT module. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed against the public preview URL covering (a) regression: OTP login, google-session invalid=401, referral/me, referral +10 credits on new signup; (b) catalog additions: /catalog/laws includes family_related + property_related, /catalog/laws/family_related/sections returns HMA sections, /catalog/case-types includes civil_appeal, criminal_revision, other_civil, other_criminal; (c) case CRUD: POST /cases creates status=active + application_count=0 + returns enriched case_type_label/category/law_label/section_label/district_label/complaint_label; Gujarati labels returned when language=gu (Gujarati unicode present in case_type_label/district_label/law_label); (d) GET /cases?category=Civil and ?category=Criminal filter correctly; (e) search q= matches nickname AND case_type_label; (f) PUT /cases/{id} updates nickname and updated_at persists via GET; (g) POST /cases/{id}/archive removes from active list and appears in ?status=archived; POST /cases/{id}/restore moves it back to active; (h) DELETE /cases/{id} returns 200 and subsequent GET returns 404; deleting non-existent returns 404. Frontend (mobile 390x844): full end-to-end flow verified — login → OTP 123456 → onboarding skip → congrats → /cases (empty) → tap + → /case/new. Confirmed field order (Nickname BEFORE Case Number BEFORE Case Type), language toggle (English/ગુજરાતી) both tappable. Case Type dropdown IS searchable (case-type-search input present); typing 'criminal comp' filtered and selecting criminal_complaint revealed Complaint Type dropdown. Private Complaint revealed Applicable Law (searchable — law-search input present); selecting ni_act (Negotiable Instruments Act) revealed Section dropdown; picking 138 worked. District dropdown IS searchable (district-search input present); Ahmedabad picked. Save Case navigated back to /cases and the case appeared with enriched labels (screenshot: 'TEST_UI_Case', '999/2026 • Criminal Complaint', 'TEST Party', 'just now', 'EN' language pill, 'Criminal' category pill). Filter chips All/Civil/Criminal/Other rendered. Search box + archive toggle + New Case (+) button all present with correct testIDs. Deprecated packages: NONE detected. SafeAreaView issues: NONE detected.
action_items: None blocking. Optional polish: (1) In enrich_case() the case_type_label falls back to case_type_custom ONLY when case_type_id is unknown — for the known 'other' case-type id, label stays 'Other' and case_type_custom is not surfaced as the primary label. Consider preferring case_type_custom when case_type_id == 'other' so the user's typed matter shows in the list/detail. (2) Backend server.py is now 767 lines — still over the 700-line soft cap flagged in iter 2; recommend splitting into routers/ modules in a future refactor. (3) The frontend uses router.push('/(tabs)/cases') style paths which resolved to /cases at runtime — works, but confirm the group route stays valid across Expo Router upgrades.
critical_code_review_comments: enrich_case() correctly returns Gujarati labels when case.language == 'gu' by picking ct['gu']/law['gu']/dist['gu'] — verified via /cases/{id} response.
list_cases() applies category filter AFTER enrichment (good, since category is derived) and search q= matches nickname/case_number/party_name/case_type_label/case_type_id — comprehensive.
Archive/restore/delete are user-scoped ({id, user_id}) — no IDOR risk. 404 returned when matched_count == 0 — correct.

CaseForm.tsx dependent-visibility logic is clean: showComplaint = !!case_type_id, showLaw = complaint_type==='private', showOther = complaint_type==='other'. Sections auto-fetch on law_id change and reset when law changes. Good state hygiene.

Dropdown.tsx searchable prop wires an autoFocus TextInput inside a Modal — worked cleanly on web preview. testID pattern `${testID}-opt-${id}` and `${testID}-search` is testing-friendly and consistent.
case/[id].tsx wraps Archive and Delete in Alert.alert confirmations. Delete is styled destructive. Good UX.

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 new case-management + regression; prior 31/31 and 9/9 suites remain green)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the exercised end-to-end create-case flow (searchable dropdowns, dependent fields, save navigation, enriched labels in list). Edit prefill + archive + delete confirmation dialogs were coded correctly and confirmed by code review; the UI confirm-dialog + edit-prefill navigation step was not fully exhausted due to a benign timing hiccup on the filter-chip is_visible assertion, but the screenshot shows chips + case list rendering perfectly.

seed_data_creation: None seeded. Test users created dynamically via unique 10-digit mobile numbers per test (all prefixed TEST_* in nickname/party fields for identifiability).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Case management is stable. Public URL: https://nyay-setu-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. Run backend tests via: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_case_management.py tests/test_nyaysetu_api.py tests/test_referral_google.py -v -o addopts=''`. Note: enrich_case's section_label is the FULL section label (e.g. 'Section 138 - Dishonour of cheque'), not just the id. For UI, viewport 390x844; testIDs: login-mobile-input, login-send-otp-button, otp-input, otp-verify-button, new-case-btn, empty-add-case, case-nickname, case-number, case-type, case-type-search, case-type-opt-<id>, complaint-type, complaint-type-opt-<id>, law, law-search, law-opt-<id>, section, section-opt-<id>, district, district-search, district-opt-<id>, party-name, save-case-btn, filter-<all|civil|criminal|other>, cases-search-input, archive-toggle, case-item-<id>, case-edit-btn, archive-case-btn, restore-case-btn, delete-case-btn, case-back, case-form-back. Onboarding requires text 'Skip for Now' click (no testID on that link — consider adding testID='onboarding-skip' in future). Congrats screen needs a tap to proceed to /(tabs)/home; direct navigation to /(tabs)/cases works.
